producer_report.summary: The drain Report now has `plan_group_sizes` and `unplanned`, both computed from the first plan before the loop starts. `unplanned` counts queued items that have no entry in view.plan. `athena drain`'s summary prints a line like `plan        group sizes 3, 1, 2; unplanned 1`. I added four tests and a CHANGELOG entry. I also added a short note to step 6 of agent-and-build-slots.md. The new tests pass. The athena-cli suite had one failure, an existing timing-based drain test that passes when rerun alone. I did not run clippy or the full `cargo test`; those are left to Athena.

checks_run.command: cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain -- group_sizes unplanned the_summary_prints

checks_run.note: 181/182 drain tests passed. every_landing_path_ends_in_reinstall_for_any_unreadable_config failed once under load. It passes alone on rerun. It is timing-based and does not touch the new fields.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`: a new test drains a plan of three groups sized 3, 1 and 2 with max_concurrency 1 and asserts the report's group sizes are exactly [3, 1, 2].
criteria_check.evidence: parallel::group_sizes_are_recorded_with_a_bound_of_one passes (drain_concurrent with bound 1, plan a,b,c free; d needs a; e,f need d) and asserts plan_group_sizes == [3, 1, 2].

criteria_check.criterion: A new test drains the same plan with max_concurrency 2 (drain_concurrent) and asserts the same sizes [3, 1, 2]; run with `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria_check.evidence: parallel::group_sizes_are_recorded_with_a_bound_of_two passes and asserts plan_group_sizes == [3, 1, 2] with drain_concurrent bound 2, and all six items land.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test has a queued item with no plan entry and asserts the report counts it in a separate unplanned field (1) and that no group of size 1 is added for it.
criteria_check.evidence: parallel::an_item_without_a_plan_entry_is_unplanned_and_not_a_group_of_one passes; it asserts unplanned == 1 and plan_group_sizes == [2].

criteria_check.criterion: A new test renders the drain summary (display.rs) and asserts it contains a group-sizes line such as 'group sizes 3, 1, 2' plus the unplanned count; run with `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
`cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` pass, including the existing record validation tests, so records still validate.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran cargo fmt --all and the athena-cli tests. Report is an in-memory struct, so no record file changed.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md gains an entry that states only what the diff does (group sizes and unplanned count in the drain report and summary), with no claim about raising max_concurrency or editing athena.toml.
criteria_check.evidence: Read CHANGELOG.md: new first bullet under Unreleased/Added; it names only plan_group_sizes, unplanned and the summary line.

criteria_check.criterion: The group sizes are computed in the drain loop from the plan's groups (crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs) and the field has a doc comment explaining unplanned vs group of 1.
criteria_check.evidence: drain.rs computes plan_group_sizes from first_plan.groups before the loop. The fields plan_group_sizes and unplanned carry doc comments, and the unplanned comment explains why it is not a group of one.

open_issues: The test every_landing_path_ends_in_reinstall_for_any_unreadable_config failed once in the full athena-cli run and passed alone on rerun. It looks like a timing flake under load; I did not investigate it further.
The max_concurrency 1 test runs through drain_concurrent with a bound of 1. It does not call plain drain(), but both use the same loop.
learnings: Report is built in one place, at the end of the shared loop in drain.rs. drain and drain_concurrent both use it, so one computation covers both paths.
The plan puts items in waves by dependency: a, b, c free; d needs a; e and f need d gives groups of 3, 1 and 2.
